sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: Hostify demonstrates modern frontend architecture without frameworks, achieving 98/100 PageSpeed score with pure HTML/CSS component patterns. The mobile-first design system with BEM methodology delivers 100% accessibility compliance and sub-second load times.

sections.title: Frontend Excellence
highlights: 98/100 Google PageSpeed score with optimized assets
0.8s First Contentful Paint for fast perceived load
15+ reusable component patterns with CSS custom properties
<200KB total bundle size with WebP optimization

sections.title: Architecture Success
sections.summary: Hostify proves that modern, performant websites don't require heavy JavaScript frameworks. The component architecture with CSS design tokens creates maintainable, scalable code while mobile-first responsive design ensures perfect rendering across all devices.

frontend.name: Component System
frontend.code:
<!-- Component Library Structure -->
<!-- components/buttons.html -->
<button class="btn btn--primary">Get Started</button>
<button class="btn btn--secondary">Learn More</button>
<button class="btn btn--accent">Buy Now</button>
<button class="btn btn--outline">Contact Sales</button>

<!-- Variations -->
<button class="btn btn--primary btn--block">Full Width</button>
<button class="btn btn--primary btn--stretched">Stretched</button>

<!-- Button Styles -->
.btn {
  border-radius: 40px;
  border: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  outline: 0;
  padding: 2rem 4vw;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}

.btn--primary {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.btn--primary:hover {
  background: #3a8ffd;
}

.btn--accent {
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: #fff;
}

.btn--block {
  width: 100%;
  display: inline-block;
}
